Wailing Soul
Channeled1 min cooldown
Summon a Wailing Soul that you can directly control for 10 sec.

The soul can see stealthed enemies, and will possess the first enemy it makes contact with, stunning them for a short time and dealing massive Shadow damage.

Summoning the soul will not remove you from Underwalk, but if it makes contact with an enemy Underwalk will fade.
